text: dsh-sidebar-rail 是一个面向 macOS DSH Desktop 的界面插件，在宿主侧栏折叠且窗口宽度足够时，通过 shell.overlay 增加默认隐藏的 56 像素导航轨。用户可浏览和置顶工作区、查看最近会话状态，并打开定时任务、已启用插件及账号信息浮层；最近会话数量可在浮层和插件设置页调整。展开侧栏后仍由 DSH 提供原生导航。适合希望折叠侧栏后仍快速访问常用入口的 macOS 桌面用户。无需额外 API 密钥；工作区置顶与显示数量保存在客户端本地。

dsh-sidebar-rail adds a hidden navigation rail for macOS DSH Desktop when the sidebar is collapsed. Hover to browse and pin workspaces, open recent sessions, or reach tasks, plugins, and account details. It stores preferences locally and needs no extra API key.
我把 DSH 侧栏收起来后，还想快速打开工作区和任务。
有没有办法在 macOS 桌面端折叠侧栏后保留导航入口？
想把常用工作区置顶，并从侧栏附近直接切换项目。
最近会话能不能直接在折叠的导航里查看和打开？
让 DSH 桌面侧栏收起时仍能进定时任务和插件页面。
I want a compact way to reach workspaces and recent sessions with the DSH sidebar collapsed.
侧栏缩起来以后，怎么快速找到刚才在处理的会话？
Can I open scheduled tasks and my enabled plugins without expanding the sidebar?
dsh-sidebar-rail 的功能「折叠侧栏导航」：在 macOS 桌面侧栏折叠、视口至少 768 像素时显示默认隐藏的导航轨；指针移到窗口左缘可唤出，悬停图标打开对应浮层。
dsh-sidebar-rail 的功能「工作区置顶和最近会话」：工作区浮层按置顶与普通项目分组，并列出最近的非归档、非空白、非子代理会话及状态；可在设置中调整显示数量。
dsh-sidebar-rail 的功能「任务与插件入口」：悬停相应图标查看尚未结束或暂停的任务，以及用户安装并启用的插件；选择条目可前往宿主对应面板。
dsh-sidebar-rail 的功能「共享最近会话数量设置」：工作区浮层和插件详情设置页共同调整最近会话条数，默认显示 5 条，并将偏好保存在客户端。
dsh-sidebar-rail 使用范围有限：只有 macOS 桌面端折叠侧栏且视口宽度至少 768 像素时才显示；Web 和其他平台不会绘制这条导航轨。

Reach workspaces, recent sessions, scheduled tasks, plugins and your account while the DeepSeek Harness sidebar is collapsed on macOS Desktop.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · dsh-sidebar-rail：The rail starts hidden. Collapse the host sidebar, then move the pointer into the 12px strip along the window's left edge to reveal a 56px icon rail. Hover an icon to browse its flyout and choose an entry to navigate. Expanding the sidebar keeps the host's search, workspace tree, account menu and settings.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Support：| Environment / state | Behaviour |
| --- | --- |
| macOS Desktop, sidebar collapsed, viewport width ≥ 768px | Hidden rail, revealed by the edge strip or keyboard focus |
| macOS Desktop, sidebar collapsed, viewport width < 768px | No rail; the host button still expands the sidebar |
| macOS Desktop, sidebar expanded | No rail; the host sidebar remains available |
| Web, any platform | No rail; the host keeps its existing collapsed rail |
| Windows / Linux Desktop | No rail; support is untested |

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Support：Recorded Desktop checks used macOS Desktop `0.2.2-rc.1`. See `peerDependencies` in [package.json](package.json) for other compatible host versions. Some new settings and balance displays still have unverified paths; see the [verification log](docs/verify.md). Source development and checks require Node.js ≥ 22.19.0, with no dependency installation or build step.
@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Install and manage：Requires the DSH **Desktop or Web client** and a profile. Installation only affects that profile; it never modifies DSH itself.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Option 2: Command line：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail
```

`dsh plugin` forwards its arguments to pnpm inside the profile directory. Replace `desktop` with the profile you actually use; a first run initializes it. You can also run `pnpm add` directly in the profile directory. Restart DSH afterwards.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Disable and uninstall：Enabling is a profile configuration switch and belongs to the Plugins page; the command line only installs and removes packages.

| Operation | How |
| --- | --- |
| Disable | Turn off the Sidebar rail switch on the Plugins page (the dependency stays installed, so re-enabling is instant) |
| Enable again | Turn the same switch on |
| Uninstall | Choose **Uninstall** on the detail page, or run `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail` |

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Disable and uninstall：The assistant can also call `plugin_manager` with `set_bundle` (enable/disable) or `remove_bundle` (uninstall). Local preferences in `localStorage` (pinned projects, recent count) survive disabling or uninstalling.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Usage：| Entry | Available actions |
| --- | --- |
| Workspaces | Browse pinned projects and projects by name; choose a name to switch workspace or use the pin button to pin or unpin it |
| Recent sessions | Scroll independently at the foot of the workspace flyout, newest first, excluding archived, blank and subagent sessions; open an existing session and see its relative time and host-provided status mark |
| Scheduled tasks | Browse tasks that have not ended or paused; choose a row or Open panel to enter the task panel |
| My plugins | Browse bundles you installed and enabled, excluding host bundles; choose a row to enter the plugin manager |
| More | Open other host panels or expand the native sidebar |
| Account and settings | See the host avatar and available balances, bonuses, View usage and Top up links; signed-out accounts get a hint; the flyout also names the path to the host Settings panel (expand the sidebar, then Settings at its foot); sign-in, sign-out and payment remain in the host or destination page |

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Usage：Keyboard: `Tab` to an icon reveals the rail. On a top-row function icon, press `↓` or `→` to enter its flyout, then `Tab` through the list. `Escape` inside the flyout closes it and returns focus to its trigger. `Enter` activates the focused button like a click; activating an icon navigates directly rather than entering its flyout list.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Preferences and local data：Recent count defaults to **5**, with a range of **1–20**. Adjust it with the stepper at the foot of the workspace flyout or on the plugin detail page. Recent sessions scroll independently when they exceed the visible height.

Preferences belong to this client and use `localStorage['dsh.sidebar-rail.v1']`:

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Preferences and local data：| Field | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `pinnedWorkspaceIds` | Pinned workspace IDs, most recently pinned first |
| `recentCount` | Number of recent rows, normalised to an integer from 1 to 20; unparseable values use the default |

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Preferences and local data：The host owns the collapse state; the plugin only reads it. Account and balance data come from host services and are not written to these preferences. Clearing client storage loses local settings. Both settings surfaces share this preference; see the [verification log](docs/verify.md) for real Desktop checks of immediate synchronisation between them.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Troubleshooting and limitations：| Symptom | Check or recovery |
| --- | --- |
| No rail after installation | Confirm macOS Desktop, the enabled plugin, a collapsed sidebar and viewport width ≥ 768px; the rail starts hidden and needs the left-edge strip |
| A recent session is missing | Check Recent count; archived, blank and subagent sessions are excluded |
| Task or plugin loading fails | Missing services, structured failures and requests exceeding 5s enter the failure state; use Open panel for the host page, or close and reopen the flyout to retry |
| No avatar or balance | A missing avatar uses a fallback glyph; unavailable balances get a hint. Account data are read on component mount and are not guaranteed to refresh live; use the host account page for full details |
| A revealed rail covers the page's left edge | It is a temporary overlay that reserves no host grid space; the hidden default preserves the conversation tab entry, and moving the pointer away lets the rail retract |
| Sidebar rail unavailable or a boot import error | Keep the visible error and host diagnostics, disable the plugin through the native sidebar, and report the host

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Troubleshooting and limitations：The plugin keeps the expanded host sidebar and its column width. The top 48px remain clear for macOS window controls; reduced-motion preferences are respected. For light themes, other platforms, real remote failures, plugin-detail settings interactions and the primary balance row on a funded account, rely on the actual results and unverified items in the [verification log](docs/verify.md).

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Development and contributions：```bash
npm test               # Pure logic and client factory registration tests
npm run check          # Repository rules, syntax checks for both entries, and tests
npm run hooks:install  # Optional: enable this repository's commit hooks
```

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Development and contributions：The client is a hand-written static module with no dependency installation or build step. Tests extract pure functions from the `#region` sections of `client.js`; the registration test requires the factory ID to match the full scoped package name. These checks do not replace real Desktop validation.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Development and contributions：Use Conventional Commits for PR titles, with the summary, description and verification results in Simplified Chinese. Keep code identifiers and original diagnostics in English. Follow the [PR template](.github/pull_request_template.md) for the problem, changes, validation and unverified items; update both README languages when behaviour changes. UI, loading or registration changes require real environment and operation results in [docs/verify.md](docs/verify.md). See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and [CODING_STANDARDS.md](CODING_STANDARDS.md) for the full rules.

@skylerfee/dsh-sidebar-rail README · Development and contributions：Follow [ADR-0003](docs/adr/0003-release-pipeline.md) to release: update and push the version, then create a GitHub Release tagged `v`. `publish.yml` validates it and uses npm OIDC trusted publishing; the npm Trusted Publisher must allow direct publishing.
